body.text:
range stuff: sure! we can pass through range. actually after the [next tower-http release](https://github.com/tower-rs/tower-http/pull/754) we can probably do if-range. if we also implement range for blobs that may be useful. for now we can just ignore range when we see if-range headers

content-length stuff: nuked. no more `0` content length

atproto-proxy stuff: yeah actually, maybe caches should know that different upstream proxies provided the response. we can also forward any `Vary` header upstream appview gave us..
